title: 12-Lead ECG Showing Atrial Fibrillation (90 bpm)
author: Ewingdo
caption: Electrocardiogram demonstrating atrial fibrillation with an irregularly irregular ventricular rhythm and absent discrete P waves.
alt_text: 12-lead ECG tracing showing irregular R-R intervals and fibrillatory baseline characteristic of atrial fibrillation.
clinical_relevance: Illustrates ECG diagnosis of atrial fibrillation referenced in CLIFF-011 (p.1, p.5-9).
